explanation: The earlier record’s own cited article says it in its § Consequences, in one sentence: "Italy would respond with the 1911–12 Italo-Turkish War leading to the Italian occupation of Libya." The same section gives what the response was to: "Great Britain and Germany silently approved the invasion of the country, while Italy protested in vain", and Tunisia became a French protectorate in 1881 with Italy shut out of a country it had claimed an interest in. `reacted-to` and not `caused`: what the article states is the answer one side gave thirty years later, not a mechanism by which the conquest produced the war. `probable` rather than `consensus`, because the only source the atlas can open here is the encyclopaedia article itself (rule 22).
